content.title: Who won the final 2026 FIFA World Cup qualifiers?
content.text: Live updates: 2026 FIFA World Cup qualifiersThe Times Union is provided updates throughout the day of games.Article continues below this ad Final: Iraq 2, Bolivia 1 1:07 a.m.: Iraq hangs on to beat Bolivia 2-1 for the final spot in the 2026 FIFA World Cup. Aymen Hussein scores for Iraq 12:29 a.m.: Aymen Hussein puts Iraq back on top 2-1 with a goal in the 53rd minute.Article continues below this ad Moises Paniagua ties it up for Bolivia 12:02 a.m.: Bolivia's Moises Paniagua scores in the 38th minute to level the score 1-1 against Iraq. Ali Ibrahim Al-Hamadi scores for Iraq 11:31 p.m.: Iraq has taken a 1-0 lead over Bolivia on a goal from Ali Ibrahim Al-Hamadi in the 10th minute.Article continues below this ad Final: Congo 1, Jamaica 0 7:53 p.m.: Axel Tuanzebe's goal in the 100th minute lifted Congo past Jamaica 1-0 and into the field for the 2026 World Cup. Axel Tuanzebe scores for Congo 7:23 p.m.: Axel Tuanzebe scores in the 100th minute to give Congo a 1-0 lead over Jamaica in extra time.Article continues below this ad Congo vs. Jamaica head to extra time 6:56 p.m.: Free soccer! Congo and Jamaica are scoreless after regulation and are heading to extra time. Congo vs. Jamaica 2nd half underway 6:05 p.m.: The second half of the scoreless match between the Congo and Jamaica is underway. Article continues below this ad Halftime: Congo vs. Jamaica scoreless 5:49 p.m.: Congo vs. Jamaica is scoreless at halftime in Guadalajara, Mexico. The game is now being broadcast on FS1. Italy misses 3rd straight World Cup 5:35 p.m.: Bosnia and Herzegovina stun Italy 4-1 in penalty kicks. Sending the Italians to their third consecutive World Cup absence.Article continues below this ad Czechia wins 3-1 on penalties 5:31 p.m.: Czechia defeats Denmark 3-1 on penalties to qualify for the 2026 FIFA World Cup. Italy vs. Bosnia, Czechia vs. Denmark head to penalties 5:26 p.m.: Italy vs. Bosnia and Herzegovina and Czechia vs. Denmark are headed to penalty kicks.Article continues below this ad Kasper Høgh scores for Denmark 5:08 p.m.: Czechia and Denmark are tied once again after Kasper Høgh scores on a header in the 111th minute, assisted by Anders Dreyer. Congo vs. Jamaica underway 5:02 p.m.: The first of two Intercontinental Playoff Tournament contests is underway between Congo and Jamaica. The game is being televised on FS2.Article continues below this ad Ladislav Krejcí gives Czechia lead vs. Denmark 4:57 p.m.: Ladislav Krejcí's goal in the 100th minute puts Czechia up 2-1 against Denmark in extra time. Game is not over yet. Italy vs. Bosnia, Czechia vs. Denmark head to extra time 4:48 p.m.: After 90 minutes, Italy vs. Bosnia and Herzegovina and Czechia vs. Denmark remain tied and head to extra time. Article continues below this ad Final: Turkey 1, Kosovo 0 4:44 p.m.: Kerem Aktürkoglu's goal in the 53rd minute lifted Turkey to a 1-0 win over Kosovo. With the win, Turkey qualifies for the 2026 FIFA World Cup and will slot into Group D, alongside the United States, Paraguay and Australia. Final: Sweden 3, Poland 2 4:42 p.m.: Viktor Gyökeres scored the tiebreaking goal in the 88th minute, and Sweden defeated Poland 3-2 to earn a spot in the 2026 FIFA World Cup. Article continues below this ad Viktor Gyökeres gives Sweden 3-2 lead vs. Poland 4:35 p.m.: Viktor Gyökeres scores in the 88th minute to put Sweden ahead 3-2 against Poland. Bosnia and Herzegovina ties it up vs. Italy 4:29 p.m.: Bosnia and Herzegovina levels the score at 1-1 in the 79th minute on a goal from Haris Tabakovic.Article continues below this ad Joachim Andersen ties it up for Denmark 4:18 p.m.: Joachim Andersen scores on a cross from Mikkel Damsgaard in the 72nd minute as Denmark levels the score 1-1 against Czechia. Kerem Aktürkoglu gives Turkey a 1-0 lead 4:07 p.m.: Kerem Aktürkoglu gives Turkey a 1-0 lead over Kosovo in the 53rd minute, assisted by Orkun Kökçü.Article continues below this ad Karol Swiderski ties it up for Poland 4:04 p.m.: Poland's Karol Swiderski levels the score at 2-2 in the 55th minute against Sweden, assisted by Nicola Zalewski. Halftime: Italy ahead in World Cup qualifier 3:45 p.m.: Italy leads Bosnia and Herzegovina 1-0 at halftime but faces a challenge of playing the second half with only 10 players after Alessandro Bastoni was shown a red card in the 41st minute. Moise Kean scored Italy's goal in the 15th minute.Article continues below this ad Halftime: Sweden leads Poland, 2-1 3:43 p.m.: Sweden has a 2-1 lead over Poland at halftime in Stockholm. The Swedes have gotten first-half goals from Anthony Elanga and Gustaf Lagerbielke, while Nicola Zalewski scored for Poland. Halftime: Czechia leads Denmark, 1-0 3:41 p.m.: Czechia leads Denmark 1-0 on a goal from Pavel Sulc in the third minute of action in Prague.Article continues below this ad Halftime: Kosovo vs. Turkey scoreless 3:39 p.m.: Kosovo and Turkey are scoreless after 45 minutes of action in Prishtina, Kosovo. Italy's Alessandro Bastoni shown red card 3:35 p.m.: Italy defender Alessandro Bastoni is shown a red card and sent off in the 41st minute after taking out Bosnia and Herzegovina's Amar Memic on a fast break. Italy leads 1-0 but will now play with just 10 men for the remainder of the game.Article continues below this ad Gustaf Lagerbielke puts Sweden back up, 2-1 3:32 p.m.: Sweden goes back on top of Poland 2-1 in the 44th minute on a goal from Gustaf Lagerbielke, assisted by Benjamin Nygren. Nicola Zalewski ties it up for Poland 3:22 p.m.: Poland draws even with Sweden in the 33rd minute on a goal from Nicola Zalewski, assisted by Piotr Zielinski. Article continues below this ad Anthony Elanga scores for Sweden 3:09 p.m.: Anthony Elanga gives Sweden a 1-0 lead over Poland in the 19th minute, assisted by Yasin Ayari. Moise Kean scores for Italy 3 p.m.: Moise Kean gives Italy a 1-0 lead over Bosnia and Herzegovina at the 15-minute mark, assisted by Nicolò Barella. Czechia leads Denmark 1-0 on a goal from Pavel Sulc in the third minute of action.Article continues below this ad UEFA World Cup qualifiers are underway 2:45 p.m.: The UEFA World Cup qualifiers are underway. Italy is taking on Bosnia and Herzegovina on FS1 and Kosovo is facing Turkey on FS2. Two more qualifiers, the Czech Republic vs. Denmark and Sweden vs. Poland, have also kicked off. 2026 World Cup will be largest ever 2 p.m.: This will be the largest World Cup ever, expanding from 32 teams in 2022 to 48, with Europe sending 16 nations to the tournament.Article continues below this adGianluca Mancini of Italy in action during the FIFA World Cup 2026 European Qualifiers KO play-offs match between Bosnia & Herzegovina and Italy at Stadion Bilino Polje on March 31, 2026 in Zenica, Bosnia and Herzegovina.
